question: If JPG = 19 and PNG = 23, then TIF = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Sum of the positional value of first two letter - positional value third letter = Number.**

Now,

JPG = 19 

⇒ J(10) + P(16) - G(7) 

⇒ 10 + 16 - 7 = 19.

For, PNG = 23, 

⇒ P(16) + N(14) - G(7) 

⇒ 16 + 14 - 7 = 23.

Similarly, for** TIF,**

**⇒ T(20) + I(9) - F(6) **

**⇒ 20 + 9 - 6 = 23.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"23"**.
